propositions: rebar-brainstorm currently instructs authors to run plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation, before dependencies are established and regardless of blocked state, contradicting actual gate behavior which fast-fails with exit 2 on blocked tickets
plan-review gates must run in dependency order (prerequisites/children before dependents) and only on unblocked tickets identified by rebar ready, not in parallel

rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md must be rewritten to establish the child dependency graph via blocks/depends_on links first, then run plan-review only on unblocked tickets in dependency order, with a fallback to diagnose cycles when rebar ready returns empty

rebar-implement/SKILL.md already implements correct behavior by claiming and reviewing only the unblocked dependency-ordered set via rebar ready/next-batch, treating the dependency graph as a precondition, and requires no changes
